_note: What each verdict does once its calibrated probability reaches a threshold (docs/02-signals.md, Verdicts). keyword: set the keywords; folder: file into folder_key, if the mailbox mode allows it. Junk's thresholds are replaced by the deployment's cost-derived threshold (firstreadd --junk-threshold). The other numbers are starting values, not measurements: each is set in the lab before its verdict drives anything for customers (docs/07-evaluation.md).
_fact_keywords: Keywords set from deterministic facts, not from a verdict; leave one out to switch it off.
_rules: A user rule written in words (rule:<id>, answered by tier 2) sets its tag as fr-<tag> once P(true) reaches this threshold.
